plugin.name: Woodshop
plugin.description: Woodworking: mark groups and components as boards with grain and edge banding; the cut list counts equal boards and saves them as CSV.

panel.selectGroups: Select one or more groups or components.

cutList.title: Cut list
cutList.empty: No boards in the model yet.

script.board: Marks a group or component as a board for the cut list: grain along the longest side (length) or across it (width), edge banding along and across the grain (0–2).
script.noGroup: s3d.board needs a group or component, e.g. from s3d.box().
